flags.message: The November 16 snapshot dates the petition filing April 15, 2026, but the petition cover is dated May 20, 2026 and its attachment URL carries a May 20 timestamp. The snapshot separately shows an April 16 order extending the filing deadline to May 20. The documents manifest repeats April 15 as entry_date. This appears to be a filing-date metadata inconsistency; no input was altered and it does not change these evaluations.
